outline:
本課程旨在介紹供應鏈管理中之相關問題及議題 。其中包含產業分析、e化概念、需求及供應管理、長鞭效應、存貨管理、延遲理論、及供應鏈管理實務。
The purpose of the course is to offer student a sound introduction of supply chain management relative issues. It includes industry analysis, E-business concept, demand and supply management, bullwhip effect, inventory management, postponement, and supply chain management practice.
schedule:
Ch 1. Introduction
Ch 2. Inventory Management and Risk Pooling
Ch 3. Network planning
Ch 4. Supply contracts
Ch 5. The Value of information
Ch 6. Supply Chain integration
7. 90 min Examination (20%)
Ch 7. Distribution strategies
Ch 8. Strategic alliances
Ch 9. Procurement and Outsourcing Strategies
Ch 10. Global Logistics and Risk Management
12. 90 min Examination (20%)
Ch 11. Coordinated product and supply chain design
Ch 12. Customer Value
Ch 13. Smart Pricing
Ch 14. Information Technology and Business Processes
17. 90 min Final Examination (20%)
assessment: 評分標準﹕For this course, total score is one hundred points (100%). Two Examination each worth twenty points (20%) and Final Examination worth twenty points (20%). Homework worth forty points (40%).
